target.statement: Simultaneous FDP upper bound (MC-THC) dominates the true FDP across all thresholds on the DAVIS drug-target interaction task, with positive residuals over 100 experiments (Figure 1b / Section 6.3)

compute.basis: Requires downloading DAVIS, training a binding-affinity predictor (e.g., DeepDTA-style) to get conformity scores, then running 100 Monte Carlo envelope experiments; all CPU-feasible but the score model training and 100 replications dominate the time.

blockers: Score model (binding affinity predictor) training pipeline may not be fully specified in code
exact reproduction of Figure 1b depends on model/score choices
title: Everywhere Valid Bounds on False Discovery Proportions in Conformal Inference
